limitations: One active Terrain is still replaced after the unchanged physical group transfer
Ground route planning stays synchronous; the previous approximately 24 second 45-carrier planning example is not fixed
Payload limits exclude active physics, index metadata, DEM, staging and interpolation scratch
Metadata index and disk usage grow with modified tile count
Write-through storage and archive restore cost more I/O than an in-memory dictionary

Short controls do not verify the user 23 model-hour freeze
